content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela face significant barriers when it comes to launching online stores. Conventional platforms such as Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving creators without the ability to accept payments. COREMERCH offers a robust solution through Stack 01 and Stack 02, enabling you to build and deploy your digital store with full ownership of your data and infrastructure. This guide focuses on using Supabase as your order database, outlining [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-nowpayments-integration-static-18|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-about-how-bangladeshi-freelancers-accept-international-payments|Everything About]]-about-github-pages-free-digital-product-store-3|everything]] you need to get your store live without relying on traditional payment processors.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The core issue with conventional payment platforms is their accessibility. When these platforms restrict access based on geography, digital creators are left without viable alternatives. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to circumvent these limitations by providing a framework that allows you to fully own and operate your digital store. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, combined with Supabase for data management and NOWPayments for crypto processing, you eliminate dependency on any single platform. This architecture empowers you to maintain control and operate unencumbered by the barriers posed by traditional payment solutions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you initiate the deployment of your digital store, ensure you have a few essential tools at your disposal. You will need a GitHub account to host your store, along with a Google account for utilizing Google Apps Script. Establish a NOWPayments account to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Additionally, create a Supabase account for managing your order database. Each of these components is free to use, enabling you to build a powerful online store without upfront costs. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which will guide you through the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools ready, the next step is to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by deploying the backend using Google Apps Script to handle order processing and payment verification through NOWPayments. Ensure that your Supabase database is set up for storing order details securely. After that, integrate the payment gateway so that transactions are confirmed on-chain, triggering automated delivery of digital products. This setup allows you to efficiently manage orders and payments while maintaining complete ownership of your infrastructure.
Own your infrastructure and eliminate dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After testing your infrastructure, it’s time to go live. Update your GitHub Pages with the necessary files and ensure your Supabase database is connected correctly. Test the payment process by executing a transaction on the mainnet using NOWPayments. Real-time transaction confirmations will automatically trigger delivery of your products. This test not only validates your setup but also builds confidence in your ability to process payments securely. Monitor the transaction closely to ensure everything is functioning as expected.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store operational, consider scaling your infrastructure to accommodate increased traffic and product offerings. Utilize the insights from the Sovereign Blueprint to add more products to your store seamlessly. As you grow, you might explore additional features within Supabase to enhance functionality, such as advanced analytics or customer management systems. Promote your store effectively through social media and other channels to attract more traffic and increase sales. Your new infrastructure can support this growth without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH. These stacks provide a complete infrastructure solution built on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, with crypto payment capabilities via NOWPayments. By following the deployment guidelines, you can create a fully functional store without incurring subscription fees or relying on conventional payment processors.
Deploy your store in hours, not weeks.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those exploring advanced setups, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) which offers a comprehensive deployment in 48 hours. By visiting https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, you can access additional resources and templates to enhance your digital store. This stack integrates Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a fully optimized experience.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script while Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 is deployed in 48 hours and offers more advanced features, making it suitable for larger operations.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages offer robust hosting solutions for your digital product store. They are reliable and allow for seamless integration with payment processing and order management systems.
What digital products can I sell using COREMERCH's infrastructure?
You can sell a variety of digital products such as ebooks, courses, templates, presets, and software. The infrastructure is flexible and supports multiple digital formats.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Deployment of Stack 01 typically takes 4-6 hours following the guidelines in the Sovereign Blueprint. This allows you to quickly set up your store and start processing transactions.
